class_id: status-restricted aggregator run drops a name discovery hasn't reached yet
symptom: prod DOES run an unrestricted NSE+BSE discovery job 4x/day (`scraper/src/index.ts:304-305`, 08:30/11:00/14:00/17:30 IST, no `allowedStatuses`) — that path is unaffected. The class is narrower: a name Chittorgarh or Moneycontrol (both restricted to UPCOMING/OPEN on their once-daily cadence) sees before NSE/BSE has listed it — typically an early-announced SME row — was silently skipped and NEVER created by a later cycle either, because there is never an existing row for the guard to match against, so the aggregator's earlier sighting was simply lost until NSE/BSE eventually discovered the same name on its own 4x/day cadence (or never, if NSE/BSE's own board omits it). 8 rows confirmed missing on prod as of 2026-09-07 (advenzymes, infrax-renewable-ltd, karamtara-engineering-ltd, manipal-payment-and-identity-solutions-ltd, rentomojo-ltd, sis, steamhouse-india-ltd, vinod-texworld-ltd) — of these, `sis` and `advenzymes` are rejected upstream BY DESIGN (`data-validation.ts` `NON_IPO_SCRIP_CODE_NAME`/`NON_IPO_WINDOW_TOO_LONG`, ~line 330/393: bare scrip-code names and no-substance long windows), so this fix creates at most 6 of the 8
